## Welcome to PhotoStructure!

**Please note that general PhotoStructure bugs and feature requests are handled on the forum, not in this repository.**

First off: apologies if PhotoStructure is misbehaving for you. It's always frustrating when software doesn't "just work."

Please visit the official [PhotoStructure Forum](https://forum.photostructure.com/c/bug/8/l/latest) and see if your bug has already been reported.

If it has, please add any additional context or system information that you think would be helpful in tracking down and solving the issue.

If it hasn't, the more context the better: and if there is information that you'd rather keep private, please email support@photostructure.com with a reference to the bug and those additional details.

## Installation and packaging problems

If you're having installation or packaging problems with the Docker or Node editions of PhotoStructure, you can open an issue in this repository, post on the [forum](https://forum.photostructure.com/c/bug/8/l/latest), or report it in [Discord](https://photostructure.com/go/discord). Wherever you report it, please include:

- **PhotoStructure version**, shown at the top of the **About** page
- **Edition** (Docker or Node) and your host OS and architecture
- **The command you ran** and its complete output, including any error

For problems with specific photos or videos, please use the forum instead: open the **System activity** page, choose **More actions**, select **Search for file diagnostics...**, enter the file path, and click **Download ZIP**. Attach the ZIP to your forum post.

Cheers!
